slot reuse, reserved slots, immutable identity and one-way observed source revocation
birth P1 survives later power selection; old P2 cannot be promoted
all 80 serialized record bytes, including unused tails and signed values
current canonical bank pointer/size, indices and coverage before cold or warm access
alignment of typed compositor buffers, non-overlap of INDEX8 and RGBA surfaces, address-range overflow
layout, pitch, coordinate, mode/context and current view rejection

visual.basis: Fresh actual Normal and Hard native2x/native4x readbacks at density8, plus native2x density4 diagnostics, from the final source freeze.
visual.finding: R2 retains readable warm cores and inward-softened contours without a new dark rim or enlarged halo. Existing Hard darkening, ship occlusion and viewport/HUD clipping remain intact.

limits: Bounded first-level Normal/Hard rear10 P1 pilot only; other powers, shop, linked/two-player, network, Galaga, Christmas, demos, special modes and alternate source layouts are excluded.
Natural runtime uses the SDL software renderer; no hardware-driver or Windows runtime claim.

The 14 ordinary manual-HD pairs use density8. Two additional actual Normal/Hard native2x density4 diagnostics change only renderer startup density in reversible private observer copies; production source and gameplay are unchanged.
Mid-flight P1-to-P2/P2-to-P1 provenance is exercised synthetically; the native P2 control is acquired through original menu input.
LeakSanitizer is unavailable under the test environment ptrace setup; ASan and UBSan pass with leak detection disabled.
Observed source mutation revokes a birth. Mutation restored before any observer executes and arbitrary process-memory corruption are outside the finite guard contract.
Synthetic gate tests observe draw admission and original wrapper counts; final pixel composition is established separately by real SDL runtime readback.
No original game-data arrays, original art, native captures, private paths or private fixture payloads are included in this review artifact.
This review covers the pinned candidate. The complete publication archive requires a separate final inventory/privacy check.
